energy.boundary: cpu + gpu + ane (macmon cpu_power, gpu_power, ane_power)
energy.counter: cpu_power + gpu_power + ane_power (W, the average over each sample) times the sample's span
energy.interval: 100 ms; each sample spans from the previous sample's timestamp to its own; each window takes the share of every sample that overlaps it
energy.net: gross joules minus the mean idle power times the run's seconds
